purchasePolicy: Before each battle, use available owned upgrades then buy higher fixed-stat-score compatible items with current gold; highest improvement per gold first, no selling, no catch-up training. Real CampaignInventory.TryBuy and EquipmentLoadout.TrySave transactions.
limits: Automated commands, not human playtime or a manual campaign completion.
Player movement/skills/facing use public BattleDirector paths; enemy turns use its normal coroutine. Story and result controls use rendered uGUI buttons.
Fresh isolated save; reward seed 17, production combat seed 17. No level/HP/outcome injection, no forced victories, no content regeneration.
timeScale accelerates presentation only. Wall seconds include automation/CPU/frame waits; scaled seconds and summed windup/recovery are separate proxies, not a human-duration estimate.
Fixed preferred party and one-action UtilityPlanner cannot establish optimal strategy, economy or balance. Dialogue is rendered and advanced automatically, not read by a person.
Pending after-story cursor is checked by disk reload after each advanced line; actual title reload is performed after each completed episode. This run does not restart a process mid-dialogue.
No optional personal scenarios, selling, manual timing success, free catch-up, rewinds or retry assistance.
